notes:
What's new in 0.1.82:
• Restoring a backup is safer: odd names hidden in a backup file can no longer slip into settings.
• Sign-in lock-outs and two-step sign-in cope with unusual saved data.
• The admin page checks the owner PIN exactly as typed.
• Settings refuse a value of the wrong kind before saving.
• Photos ignore impossible time-zone offsets; collections list a repeated film once.
• Watch Together: leaving a room no longer counts against your open-room limit.
• Internet radio playlists with relative entries or spaces now play.
• Chromecast: a TV that also says Android TV gets the Chromecast settings.
• The installer is not code-signed.
• Built from commit 54cce55b1, Oct 7, 2026, 11:30 AM Eastern.
